name: cosmos-stockdata-tools
description: Incrementally grow China stock-data scripts in each user's durable external workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Grow durable per-user stock-data scripts safely.
interface.longDescription: Keeps the installed plugin instruction-only while each user accumulates reusable China stock-data scripts in a durable external workspace as requirements arrive; plugin or marketplace updates do not own that workspace. Each extension preserves existing behavior and follows the source priority SuperMind, then baostock, then AKShare, with explicit provenance and contract-specific validation.
defaultPrompt: Create the first stock-data script in my durable external workspace, starting with SuperMind.
Extend my existing stockdata workspace with another requested dataset.
Run a capability already accumulated in my stockdata workspace.
